title.narrative: Strengthening the Capacity of Judiciary in Handling Environmental Land-Grabbing Cases

description.narrative: The project's expected effects are strengthened capacity of judiciary in applying human rights principles when handling administrative lawsuits involving land-grabbing and the protection of the environment. The outcomes are: 1) Accessible and comprehensive reference on administrative court decisions over environmental land-grabbing cases, and 2) Enhanced capacity of administrative court judges and legal aid organizations in applying human rights principles in environmental land-grabbing cases. The outpus are 1) Research report on the principles and practices of human rights protection on land-grabbing cases in administrative court decisions, 2) Human rights training module for administrative court judges, 3) Human rights training for administrative court judges, and 4) Training module on human rights and land-grabbing lawsuits for legal aid organizations.
